t: The Bristan Wall Mount 11 shower fixing kit provides a secure, professional method for installing bar valves onto wall surfaces. This kit is ideal for plumbers and bathroom installers working on modern domestic renovations. Constructed from durable brass with a sleek chrome-plated finish, the rigid system ensures accurate 150mm centres during installation. It connects directly to standard 15mm pipework using compression fittings, providing a reliable, leak-free connection. The package includes front and rear shrouds to deliver a clean, streamlined finish that conceals pipework.
